notes: v646 - TODAY'S PICKS is now in the app. There is a new button in the top toolbar: it shows the shares that met the tested rules on the latest market day - a 20% trailing stop with no take-profit, shares priced $0.20 to $0.99, a patient limit 5% under the last close, and a minimum evidence score of 7. This selection has been running on the server for weeks, but the only way to see it was a separate admin page with its own password, so in practice nobody read it. Each pick shows the price to buy under, where the trailing stop starts, the signal that fired and its score, and a button through to that share's full report card. A second tab shows the older 15% target / 15% stop set, kept running side by side as a comparison. Three things the page tells you outright rather than leaving you to work out: whether the picks are actually from the latest market day, whether any pick is older than that, and whether a price has drifted outside the band since it was chosen. IT DOES NOT BUY ANYTHING. It shows what the rules chose; you still buy in the normal way, and every position cap and stop rule applies exactly as before. An empty list is normal - four gates in a row often leave nothing on a given day, which is the rules being choosy rather than a fault. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
